title: GitHub - lucidrains/meshgpt-pytorch: Implementation of MeshGPT, SOTA Mesh generation using Attention, in Pytorch
author: fisj

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: I posted the paper a while back. This is an implementation. Looks promising, tho I havent tried it yet. This is probably the best game asset appropriate research I've seen. Anyone tried it?

replies.author: MTOMalley
replies.body: Looks wicked but my rig is too weak

comments.author: nomagneticmonopoles
comments.body: What's this for? Simplifying meshes generated via AI? I'm not following.

replies.author: fisj
replies.body: Its an AI model that generates a 3d mesh from a single image as input (known as one shot). RIght now the results aren't AAA quality (they're barely usable), but the time to generate the 3dmodels (inference time) is extremely fast in comparison to previous state of the art. Not only that, the license is very permissive, allowing even commercial use. This model's release should be seen as a turning point in 3d generation. (imho)
